deberta-small.name: cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-small
deberta-small.initialization: NLI encoder and pooler reused; three-way NLI classifier replaced with a seeded random binary KEEP/REJECT head. All parameters fine-tuned.

bert-tiny.name: google/bert_uncased_L-2_H-128_A-2
bert-tiny.initialization: Pretrained encoder with seeded random binary sequence classifier; all parameters fine-tuned.

truncation: Complete Title prefix/title first, then Body prefix and beginning of body within 384 tokens including specials; no hypothesis. Overlong title fails open at inference and is an error in training. No occupational extraction.
loss: Cross entropy with inverse-frequency weights computed only on each training partition. Validation uses unweighted cross entropy.
checkpointSelection: Lowest validation cross entropy among fixed epochs; no evaluation-label access for checkpoint or threshold selection.
operatingPoints: For each fold, choose largest threshold satisfying validation KEEP recall >=99%, >=98%, and 100%, using grid plus validation KEEP-score boundary. Freeze it before scoring employer-held-out evaluation. Aggregate held-out predictions; never adjust thresholds to fix evaluation errors.
cache: Assign each cache posting to the model whose evaluation fold excludes its employer from training and validation. Report full 1503 snapshot and unlabeled-only subset excluding all 347 references. No full-data fit or in-training cache score used as evidence.
diagnostics: On evaluation rows only, compare masking known company identifiers with neutral text and replacing body beginning with body end. Use train-only title TF-IDF similarity for lexical novelty slices, not a claimed occupation-family holdout. No new rules or post-result model/hyperparameter changes.
selectionBoundary: Protocol and splits frozen before training; same splits for four candidates. All results are development research, not the blinded production holdout. No generative model labeling/inference.
